title: Vanilla+
description: Vanilla+ adds some stuff that makes Vanilla Minecraft better
body:
Vanilla+ is a mod that improves the vanilla experience for early-game and late-game survival.

Right-clicking a fully grown crop plants it. The Campfire Boost perk allows players to have regeneration and saturation when they are near burning campfires, which also slows down nearby hostile mobs. In late-game, the Armor Comfort perk grants players haste when they wear full netherite armor sets.
